issues.legal_issue: The allotting authority breached its reciprocal contractual obligations by failing to secure required statutory approvals and execute the documents necessary to sublease the property.
A party is entitled to recover amounts forfeited under an allotment when the allotting authority breached its reciprocal contractual obligations.
A party’s conduct and failure to approach the court with clean hands may disentitle it to discretionary interest on a refund.
Interest may be awarded on a refund if the amount is not paid within the period directed by the court.
